title: A 10-second gap in 1972 grew to 37 by 2017. The record only climbs.

scenes.purpose: Show the one fact before anything else: the record only climbs, in these two numbers.

visual.description: Two stat tiles fill the phone screen, left 1972 / 10 s, right 2017 / 37 s, joined by a single line that rises left to right in even steps and never dips; the hook line types on above the tiles before the line draws.

chart.title: TAI minus UTC
chart.note: The table's value only ever rises between these tiles; it never falls.

scenes.direction: Hard cut in on the hook line; the tiles and connecting line draw as the narration crosses from '10' to '37'.
scenes.narration: A record that only climbs. It ran from 10 in 1972 to 37 in 2017.

scenes.purpose: Send the viewer to the full video without restating the finding.

visual.description: The end card: institutional seal above, this line below in large serif, then the eyebrow and caption draw themselves.

scenes.direction: Cut to the end card; hold through the close.
